annotations.title: Download several clips as one zip

description:
Use this when the user wants several clips in one file: "download all my clips", "zip the batch". Returns
download_url, a private five-minute link (keep it private) to a zip with the videos, captions.txt and
clips.csv.
Not for: one clip (get_download_link) or one video of all of them (combine_clips). Free: no Horizon Units.

clip_ids.description: Clip ids from list_clips, up to 100. Photos are left out.

project_id.description: Project id from list_projects: zips every clip made from that video. Give clip_ids or this, or neither for the newest batch.
